description: Presidential Secretariat - Amend the Duties & Function in Gaz. Ex. ord. No. 2103/33; Public Admin.; Agricultural etc.
categorisation: This gazette contains both the naming of a specific individual (President Maithripala Sirisena) and detailed descriptions of ministerial portfolio responsibilities. It amends the assignment of functions and subjects to specific ministries, including detailed policy formulation and program monitoring responsibilities for Agriculture, Livestock Development, Irrigation, Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, as well as Public Administration, Disaster Management and Rural Economic Affairs. This meets the criteria for Hybrid (Type 3) as it includes both "who" (the President making the changes) and "what" (detailed ministerial responsibilities and subject areas).
